# Atlas Design & Build

> Atlas Design & Build is a husband and wife owned design-build firm serving Bucks County, Montgomery County and the Lehigh Valley. We pair more than 20 years of construction and project management experience with certified interior design, and we guide every project through a planned, communication-first process.

Atlas Design & Build plans, designs and builds kitchen remodels, bathroom remodels, basement finishing, whole home renovations, tile installation and interior millwork. We work across Bucks County, Montgomery County and the Lehigh Valley in Pennsylvania, including Easton, Forks Township, Palmer Township, Williams Township and Bethlehem Township. Every project is managed by the owners, from the first walkthrough to the final punch list. Phone: (484) 541-9818. Email: info@atlasdesignandbuild.com.

## Services

- [Kitchen remodeling](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/services/kitchen/): Custom kitchen design and construction, from layout changes to cabinetry, stone and lighting.
- [Bathroom remodeling](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/services/bathroom/): Primary suites, hall baths and powder rooms, designed and built by one team.
- [Basement finishing](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/services/basement/): Finished lower levels planned around moisture, layout and how the space will be used.
- [Whole home renovation](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/services/whole-home-renovation/): Multi-room renovations with layout, systems and finishes planned as one project.
- [Tile installation](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/services/tile-installation/): Showers, floors and backsplashes, including standalone tile projects.
- [Interior millwork](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/services/interior-millwork/): Built-ins, wainscoting, trim packages and coffered ceilings.

## Cost guides

- [Kitchen remodel cost in Bucks County](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/guides/kitchen-remodel-cost-bucks-county/): Kitchen remodels run $35,000 to $275,000 or more depending on scope.
- [Kitchen remodel cost in the Lehigh Valley](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/guides/kitchen-remodel-cost-lehigh-valley/): Kitchen remodel ranges for Easton, Forks Township and nearby towns, by scope.
- [Kitchen remodel cost calculator](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/guides/kitchen-remodel-cost-calculator/): How a kitchen budget typically splits across cabinetry, counters, appliances and labor.
- [Doylestown kitchen remodel cost](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/guides/doylestown-kitchen-remodel-cost/): Kitchen remodel ranges for Doylestown homes and the site conditions older houses bring.
- [10x10 kitchen remodel cost](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/guides/10x10-kitchen-remodel-cost/): What the 10x10 cabinet standard means and what a kitchen that size costs in Bucks County.
- [Low cost kitchen remodel](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/guides/low-cost-kitchen-remodel/): What a $35,000 to $75,000 kitchen remodel includes in Bucks County.
- [Bathroom remodel cost in Bucks County](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/guides/bathroom-remodel-cost-bucks-county/): Bathroom remodels run $25,000 to $110,000 or more depending on scope.
- [Bathroom remodel cost in the Lehigh Valley](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/guides/bathroom-remodel-cost-lehigh-valley/): Most bathroom remodels run $25,000 to $95,000, with custom primary suites from $110,000.
- [Newtown bathroom remodel cost](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/guides/newtown-bathroom-remodel-cost/): Bathroom ranges from powder rooms to primary suites in the Newtown area.
- [Basement finishing cost in Bucks County](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/guides/basement-finishing-cost-bucks-county/): Basement finishing runs $35,000 to $180,000 or more depending on scope and plumbing.
- [Basement finishing cost in the Lehigh Valley](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/guides/basement-finishing-cost-lehigh-valley/): Basement finishing ranges for Easton, Forks Township and nearby towns.
- [Basement finishing cost calculator](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/guides/basement-finishing-cost-calculator/): An estimator for basement finishing costs in Bucks County, with what drives the number.
- [Home addition cost in Bucks County](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/guides/home-addition-cost-bucks-county/): Home additions run $80,000 to $650,000 or more depending on type.
- [Home addition cost in the Lehigh Valley](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/guides/home-addition-cost-lehigh-valley/): Addition ranges from bump-outs to two-story additions in Easton, Forks Township and nearby towns.
- [Home addition cost per square foot in PA](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/guides/home-addition-cost-per-square-foot-pa/): Per-square-foot ranges for additions in Pennsylvania and why they run higher than new construction.
- [Whole home renovation cost in Bucks County](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/guides/whole-home-renovation-cost-bucks-county/): Whole home renovations run $250,000 to $750,000 or more depending on size and depth of work.
- [Tile flooring cost in Bucks County](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/guides/tile-flooring-cost-bucks-county/): Installed tile flooring costs per square foot for ceramic, porcelain and natural stone.
- [Interior millwork cost in Bucks County](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/guides/interior-millwork-cost-bucks-county/): Millwork runs $3,000 for a single room of trim to $65,000 or more for a whole home package.
- [Custom built-ins cost in Bucks County](https://atlasdesignandbuild.com/guides/custom-built-ins-cost-bucks-county/): Built-ins run $2,500 for a simple shelving unit to $20,000 or more for a whole room package.
